_template_for_new_rounds: 이 파일을 새 회차의 {N}-workbook.json 작성 시 템플릿으로 사용. en_template의 {{N:A/B}} 토큰 = 양자택일 박스, hints 배열 = 빈칸 첫글자, jumble.words = 단어 배열 (셔플 X, 의도 유지).

definitions.def: to put something inside an envelope or package along with other things
to end or finish something such as a letter or speech
to officially tell people about something
to welcome someone in a friendly way
to make someone feel happier or more cheerful

grammar_choice.en_template: As part of a kindness project, Orange High School students {{1:wrote/written}} cheerful letters to elders in a countryside village.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 친절 프로젝트의 일환으로, Orange 고등학교 학생들은 시골 마을의 어르신들에게 밝은 편지를 썼다.
explain: 문장의 본동사 자리 — 과거형 wrote (과거분사 written 불가).

grammar_choice.en_template: Anna wrote {{1:to/for}} Mrs. Pike.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Anna는 Pike 부인에게 편지를 썼다.
explain: write to + 사람: ~에게 (편지를) 쓰다 — 방향의 to.

grammar_choice.en_template: She shared about her balcony garden at home and {{1:included/including}} drawings of flowers.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그녀는 집에 있는 자신의 발코니 정원에 대해 이야기하고 꽃 그림을 동봉했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Anna mentioned that {{1:despite/although}} having limited space, she enjoyed {{2:taking/to take}} care of her plants.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Anna는 공간이 제한적임에도 자신의 식물을 돌보는 것을 즐긴다고 언급했다.
explain: 뒤에 동명사구(having)가 옴 → 전치사 despite (although는 절을 이끔).

grammar_choice.en_template: Her letter concluded by {{1:expressing/express}} hope {{2:that/what}} Mrs. Pike also had a nice garden.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그녀의 편지는 Pike 부인도 멋진 정원을 가지고 있기를 바란다는 말로 끝맺었다.
explain: hope의 내용을 설명하는 동격 that절 — 완전한 절을 이끄는 that.

grammar_choice.en_template: After {{1:sending/sent}} the letter, Anna forgot about it until a month later when a package {{2:arrived/was arrived}} at her home.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 편지를 보낸 후, Anna는 한 달 뒤 집에 소포가 도착할 때까지 그것을 잊고 있었다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Anna {{1:noticed/noticing}} the box in front of her door.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Anna는 문 앞에 있는 상자를 알아차렸다.

grammar_choice.en_template: She walked closer and saw {{1:it was/it being}} addressed to her.
grammar_choice.ko_full: (d)그녀는 더 가까이 걸어가 그것이 자신에게 온 것임을 보았다.
explain: saw의 목적어 명사절(접속사 that 생략) — 정상 절 it was.

grammar_choice.en_template: When Anna opened it, she {{1:found/finded}} a folded letter and a jar of homemade strawberry mint jam {{2:from/by}} Mrs. Pike.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Anna가 그것을 열었을 때, 그녀는 접힌 편지 한 통과 Pike 부인이 보낸 집에서 만든 딸기민트 잼 한 병을 발견했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: She wrote, "Your words {{1:made/let}} me smile. I {{2:used to have/used to having}} a garden, but when my husband died, I stopped planting. Your letter reminded me how much I missed it. So I planted some herbs. Have a taste!"
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그녀는 "당신의 말이 저를 미소 짓게 했어요. 저는 예전에 정원을 가지고 있었지만, 남편이 세상을 떠났을 때 심는 것을 그만두었어요. 당신의 편지가 제가 그것을 얼마나 그리워했는지 일깨워 주었어요. 그래서 저는 허브를 좀 심었답니다. 맛보세요!"라고 썼다.
explain: used to + 동사원형 = 예전에 ~했다 — used to have.

grammar_choice.en_template: The letter {{1:was signed/signed}}, "Love, Mrs. Pike."
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그 편지는 "사랑을 담아, Pike 부인"이라고 서명되어 있었다.
explain: 편지가 서명되는 대상 → 수동태 was signed.

grammar_choice.en_template: Anna was deeply {{1:moved/moving}} by Mrs. Pike's response.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Anna는 Pike 부인의 답장에 깊이 감동했다.
explain: Anna가 감동을 '받은' 것 → 수동의 과거분사 moved (be moved 감동받다).

grammar_choice.en_template: When her teacher announced that her class {{1:would/will}} visit the village {{2:to meet/meeting}} the seniors, Anna was thrilled.

grammar_choice.en_template: As they arrived, Mrs. Pike {{1:warmly/warm}} greeted Anna with open arms.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그들이 도착하자, Pike 부인은 두 팔을 벌려 Anna를 따뜻하게 맞이했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: She pointed to a green space beside her house, {{1:saying/said}}, "Look at my herbs."
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그녀는 집 옆의 푸른 공간을 가리키며 "제 허브를 보세요"라고 말했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Anna smiled and commented on {{1:how/what}} wonderful they must smell.

explain: how + 형용사(wonderful) + 주어 + 동사 — 간접의문문은 how.

grammar_choice.en_template: Together, they spent the day {{1:planting/to plant}} seeds.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 함께 그들은 하루 동안 씨앗을 심으며 보냈다.
explain: spend + 시간 + 동명사 = ~하며 시간을 보내다 — planting.

grammar_choice.en_template: Mrs. Pike even gave Anna some herbs {{1:to take/taking}} home.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Pike 부인은 심지어 Anna에게 집에 가져갈 허브를 좀 주었다.
explain: herbs를 수식하는 형용사적 to부정사('가져갈') — to take.

grammar_choice.en_template: Mrs. Pike thanked Anna {{1:for/of}} {{2:brightening/brighten}} her spirit.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Pike 부인은 자신의 기운을 북돋아 준 것에 대해 Anna에게 고마워했다.
explain: thank A for B — 전치사 for.

grammar_choice.en_template: After the visit, Anna {{1:continued/continues}} writing to Mrs. Pike every month.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 방문 후, Anna는 매달 Pike 부인에게 계속 편지를 썼다.
explain: 과거 시점 서술(After the visit) — 과거형 continued.

grammar_choice.en_template: She also started a gardening club {{1:where/which}} students planted seeds in recycled jars and cups.

grammar_choice.en_template: Anna used the empty jam jar to plant some rosemary, {{1:which/that}} reminded her {{2:of/about}} Mrs. Pike's herb garden.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Anna는 빈 잼 병을 사용해 로즈마리를 좀 심었고, 그것은 그녀에게 Pike 부인의 허브 정원을 떠올리게 했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: The rosemary {{1:grew/grown}} by the window.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 로즈마리는 창가에서 자랐다.

jumble.answer: As part of a kindness project, Orange High School students wrote cheerful letters to elders in a countryside village.
Anna wrote to Mrs. Pike.
She shared about her balcony garden at home and included drawings of flowers.
Anna mentioned that despite having limited space, she enjoyed taking care of her plants.
Her letter concluded by expressing hope that Mrs. Pike also had a nice garden.
After sending the letter, Anna forgot about it until a month later when a package arrived at her home.
Anna noticed the box in front of her door.
She walked closer and saw it was addressed to her.
When Anna opened it, she found a folded letter and a jar of homemade strawberry mint jam from Mrs. Pike.
She wrote, "Your words made me smile. I used to have a garden, but when my husband died, I stopped planting. Your letter reminded me how much I missed it. So I planted some herbs. Have a taste!"
The letter was signed, "Love, Mrs. Pike."
Anna was deeply moved by Mrs. Pike's response.
When her teacher announced that her class would visit the village to meet the seniors, Anna was thrilled.
As they arrived, Mrs. Pike warmly greeted Anna with open arms.
She pointed to a green space beside her house, saying, "Look at my herbs."
